easy: Having to do with the tiny tubes that carry blood through a body or juices through a plant.

ex.en: Your heart and vascular system move blood all around your body.
ex.ko: 심장과 혈관계는 몸 구석구석으로 피를 보낸다.

easy: Made bigger, larger, or stronger by adding more.

ex.en: With two new kids, our augmented team had twelve players.
ex.ko: 새로 온 두 아이 덕분에 늘어난 우리 팀은 선수가 열두 명이 되었다.

easy: A person whose job is to make and serve drinks at a bar.

ex.en: The bartender poured a glass of orange juice for my dad.
ex.ko: 바텐더가 아빠에게 오렌지 주스 한 잔을 따라 주었다.

easy: Coming from Bohemia, an old region that is now part of the Czech Republic, or its people.

ex.en: We saw a beautiful Bohemian glass vase at the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 박물관에서 아름다운 보헤미아 유리 꽃병을 보았다.

easy: To feed a baby milk from the mother's own body.

ex.en: My aunt breastfeeds her new baby every few hours.
ex.ko: 이모는 갓 태어난 아기에게 몇 시간마다 모유를 먹인다.

easy: A very large group of soldiers in an army, made of several smaller groups.

ex.en: The general led a whole corps of soldiers across the river.
ex.ko: 장군은 군단 전체를 이끌고 강을 건넜다.

easy: A small, fast warship with many big guns.

ex.en: The destroyer raced across the ocean to protect the other ships.
ex.ko: 구축함은 다른 배들을 지키려고 바다를 가로질러 달려갔다.

easy: The area of churches that one bishop is in charge of.

ex.en: There are twenty churches in our city's diocese.
ex.ko: 우리 도시 교구에는 교회가 스무 곳 있다.

easy: The part of the US government that keeps airplane travel safe.

ex.en: The FAA checks that airplanes are safe before they fly.
ex.ko: 미국 연방 항공청은 비행기가 뜨기 전에 안전한지 확인한다.

easy: How well people or groups get along with each other.

ex.en: After saying sorry, the two friends were back on a friendly footing.
ex.ko: 미안하다고 말한 뒤 두 친구는 다시 사이가 좋아졌다.

easy: A person who grows plants or crops, like a farmer.

ex.en: The apple grower let us pick fruit right from his trees.
ex.ko: 사과 재배 농부는 우리가 나무에서 직접 사과를 따게 해 주었다.

easy: A person who strongly dislikes someone or something.

ex.en: My brother is a hater of broccoli, but he loves carrots.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 브로콜리를 싫어하지만 당근은 아주 좋아한다.

easy: A man who leads the prayers in a mosque, a place where Muslims worship.

ex.en: The imam led the prayers at the mosque on Friday.
ex.ko: 이맘이 금요일에 모스크에서 기도를 이끌었다.

easy: To officially say in court that someone is charged with a crime.

ex.en: The court indicted the man for stealing three cars.
ex.ko: 법원은 자동차 세 대를 훔친 혐의로 그 남자를 기소했다.

easy: A way of thinking about government that wants to make life better by changing laws step by step.

ex.en: My sister learned about liberalism in her history class.
ex.ko: 언니는 역사 시간에 자유주의에 대해 배웠다.

easy: A unit for measuring liquid, a little more than a quart.

ex.en: We brought a two-litre bottle of water to the picnic.
ex.ko: 우리는 소풍에 2리터짜리 물병을 가져갔다.

easy: A party where people meet and get to know each other.

ex.en: The school had a mixer so new families could meet.
ex.ko: 학교는 새로 온 가족들이 서로 만날 수 있도록 친목회를 열었다.

easy: A strong drug that stops pain or makes people sleepy; it can be very harmful if misused.

ex.en: Doctors use narcotics very carefully because they can be dangerous.
ex.ko: 마약성 약은 위험할 수 있어서 의사들은 아주 조심해서 쓴다.

easy: A small lump of gold or another precious metal found in the ground.

ex.en: The miner found a shiny gold nugget in the river.
ex.ko: 광부는 강에서 반짝이는 금덩이를 찾았다.

easy: Needing to be paid, or able to be paid.

ex.en: The library fine is payable at the front desk.
ex.ko: 도서관 연체료는 안내 데스크에서 내면 된다.

easy: To make two things fit together or agree with each other.

ex.en: She tried to reconcile the two different stories her friends told.
ex.ko: 그녀는 친구들이 한 서로 다른 두 이야기를 맞춰 보려고 했다.

easy: To walk or travel around without going anywhere special.

ex.en: Wild horses roam across the open fields.
ex.ko: 야생마들이 넓은 들판을 돌아다닌다.

easy: A condition that makes it hard for a person to sit still, pay attention, or wait their turn.

ex.en: My classmate has ADHD, so he takes short breaks to move around.
ex.ko: 우리 반 친구는 ADHD가 있어서 잠깐씩 쉬며 몸을 움직인다.

easy: An escape from a prison.

ex.en: The movie was about a daring breakout from an old prison.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 오래된 감옥에서의 대담한 탈옥 이야기였다.

easy: A tall palm tree that grows coconuts.

ex.en: A coco palm grew tall on the sandy beach.
ex.ko: 모래 해변에 코코야자 나무가 높이 자라 있었다.

easy: A tall metal tower built over an oil well to help drill into the ground.

ex.en: A tall derrick stood over the oil well in the desert.
ex.ko: 사막의 유정 위에 높은 시추탑이 서 있었다.

easy: Having to do with a church.

ex.en: The old ecclesiastical building had colorful stained glass windows.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 교회 건물에는 알록달록한 스테인드글라스 창문이 있었다.

easy: Knowing a lot and having wise, fair ideas.

ex.en: The enlightened king built schools for all the children.
ex.ko: 깨우친 왕은 모든 아이를 위해 학교를 지었다.

easy: Remembering something and being careful about it.

ex.en: Be mindful of the little kids when you run on the playground.
ex.ko: 운동장에서 뛸 때는 어린아이들을 조심해.

easy: A strong-smelling substance that comes from a male musk deer and is used in perfume.

ex.en: The old perfume had a deep smell of musk.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 향수에서는 짙은 사향 냄새가 났다.

easy: Having to do with ships, sailors, or sailing on the sea.

ex.en: The captain studied the nautical map before we sailed.
ex.ko: 선장은 출항하기 전에 해도를 살펴보았다.

easy: Having a normal, healthy mind that thinks clearly.

ex.en: After a week of rain and bored kids, Mom joked that she was losing her sanity.
ex.ko: 일주일 내내 비가 오고 아이들이 심심해하자 엄마는 정신이 나갈 것 같다고 농담했다.

easy: To make something very hot and dry, or burn its surface.

ex.en: The summer sun scorched the grass in our backyard.
ex.ko: 여름 햇볕에 뒷마당 잔디가 바싹 타 버렸다.

easy: A big, final fight or contest between two sides.

ex.en: The two best teams met for a showdown in the final game.
ex.ko: 가장 잘하는 두 팀이 결승전에서 맞붙었다.

easy: A dreamy state where you seem awake but do not notice what is around you.

ex.en: The music was so beautiful that I sat there in a trance.
ex.ko: 음악이 너무 아름다워서 나는 넋을 잃고 앉아 있었다.

easy: How easily a liquid or solid turns into a gas.

ex.en: Because of its volatility, gasoline dries up very quickly.
ex.ko: 휘발성 때문에 휘발유는 아주 빨리 날아가 버린다.

easy: A word you use when you go back to your main point or say what really matters.

ex.en: Anyhow, the cake was delicious, so nobody cared that it was late.
ex.ko: 어쨌든 케이크가 맛있어서 늦은 건 아무도 신경 쓰지 않았다.

easy: Having to do with how things like rockets or balls fly through the air after being launched.

ex.en: Scientists studied the ballistic path of the rocket.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 로켓의 탄도를 연구했다.

easy: To take something away from someone because they broke a rule or a law.

ex.en: The teacher confiscated my phone during class.
ex.ko: 선생님이 수업 중에 내 휴대폰을 압수하셨다.

easy: A mix of things made by following an exact recipe, like a medicine.

ex.en: This new formulation of the cough syrup tastes like cherries.
ex.ko: 새로 나온 이 기침 시럽은 체리 맛이 난다.

easy: A big container shaped like a funnel that lets things slide down through a hole at the bottom.

ex.en: The farmer poured corn into the hopper.
ex.ko: 농부가 호퍼에 옥수수를 부었다.

easy: A Buddhist priest or teacher in Tibet or Mongolia.

ex.en: The lama taught the young monks how to meditate.
ex.ko: 라마는 어린 승려들에게 명상하는 법을 가르쳤다.

easy: To give an order as a ruler or leader with power.

ex.en: The king ordained that every child must go to school.
ex.ko: 왕은 모든 아이가 학교에 다녀야 한다고 명했다.

easy: To kick a football after dropping it from your hands, before it hits the ground.

ex.en: The player punted the ball far down the field.
ex.ko: 선수가 공을 경기장 저 멀리까지 찼다.

easy: A boat with a flat bottom that you push along with a long pole in shallow water.

ex.en: We rode in a punt while a man pushed it with a long pole.
ex.ko: 한 남자가 긴 장대로 밀어 주는 평평한 배를 우리가 탔다.

easy: A bird that hunts and eats other animals, like an eagle or a hawk.

ex.en: An eagle is a raptor that hunts fish and rabbits.
ex.ko: 독수리는 물고기와 토끼를 사냥하는 맹금이다.

easy: Extra soldiers or supplies sent to help an army.

ex.en: The tired soldiers waited for reinforcements to arrive.
ex.ko: 지친 군인들은 지원군이 오기를 기다렸다.

easy: One of the two main groups of Islam, with many followers in Iran.

ex.en: Many people in Iran follow Shia Islam.
ex.ko: 이란의 많은 사람들은 이슬람교 시아파를 따른다.

easy: A worried, upset feeling.

ex.en: Don't get in a stew about the spelling test; you studied hard.
ex.ko: 받아쓰기 시험 때문에 안달하지 마. 열심히 공부했잖아.

easy: A Muslim who belongs to the largest group of Islam.

ex.en: Most Muslims in the world are Sunnis.
ex.ko: 세계 무슬림의 대부분은 수니파이다.

easy: To say that something is true, often without proof.

ex.en: My brother alleged that I ate his cookie, but I didn't.
ex.ko: 형은 내가 자기 쿠키를 먹었다고 주장했지만 나는 안 먹었다.

easy: One of the important early teachers who spread Christianity.

ex.en: Paul was an apostle who traveled far to teach people.
ex.ko: 바울은 사람들을 가르치려고 먼 곳까지 여행한 사도였다.

easy: Having to do with using science to help medicine and health.

ex.en: My aunt works in a biomedical lab that makes new medicines.
ex.ko: 이모는 새 약을 만드는 생물 의학 연구소에서 일한다.

easy: A part that joins two things together, like the end of a cable.

ex.en: Plug the connector into the side of the computer.
ex.ko: 커넥터를 컴퓨터 옆쪽에 꽂아.

easy: A person whose ideas go much too far, far from what most people think is fair.

ex.en: The news warned about extremists who want to cause trouble.
ex.ko: 뉴스에서 문제를 일으키려는 극단주의자들에 대해 경고했다.

easy: A moving up and down, like waves.

ex.en: We watched the fluctuation of the waves at the beach.
ex.ko: 우리는 바닷가에서 파도가 출렁이는 것을 보았다.

easy: A false look someone puts on to hide who they really are.

ex.en: The wolf came to the door in the guise of a grandmother.
ex.ko: 늑대는 할머니로 가장하고 문 앞에 왔다.

easy: A group that helps people but is not part of any government.

ex.en: An NGO helped build a new school in the village.
ex.ko: 한 비정부 기구가 그 마을에 새 학교를 짓는 것을 도왔다.

easy: The time when a child's body starts growing and changing into an adult's body.

ex.en: We will learn about puberty in health class next year.
ex.ko: 우리는 내년에 보건 시간에 사춘기에 대해 배울 것이다.

easy: A person who reads a book or paper before it is printed and decides if it is good enough.

ex.en: The reviewer said my aunt's book was ready to be printed.
ex.ko: 검토자는 이모의 책이 인쇄해도 될 만큼 준비되었다고 말했다.

easy: A person who travels from place to place and does not stay anywhere for long.

ex.en: The wanderer walked from town to town with his dog.
ex.ko: 방랑자는 개와 함께 이 마을 저 마을을 걸어 다녔다.

easy: Having had a Christian ceremony where water is used to welcome someone into the church.

ex.en: My baby cousin was baptized at church last Sunday.
ex.ko: 내 아기 사촌은 지난 일요일에 교회에서 세례를 받았다.

easy: A business that gives expert advice to other companies.

ex.en: My dad works at a consultancy that helps companies grow.
ex.ko: 아빠는 회사들이 성장하도록 돕는 컨설팅 회사에서 일하신다.

easy: Very bad and mean, so that people feel disgust.

ex.en: Stealing lunch money from a little kid is despicable.
ex.ko: 어린아이의 점심값을 빼앗는 것은 비열한 짓이다.

easy: Causing trouble or noise that stops things from going smoothly.

ex.en: The disruptive noise in the hall made it hard to take the test.
ex.ko: 복도의 시끄러운 소리 때문에 시험을 보기가 힘들었다.

easy: An illness of the brain that can make a person suddenly shake and pass out.

ex.en: My classmate has epilepsy, so our teacher knows how to help if she has a seizure.
ex.ko: 우리 반 친구는 뇌전증이 있어서 선생님은 발작이 일어나면 어떻게 도울지 알고 계신다.

easy: A clear liquid made from plants like corn; it is used in some fuels and is the alcohol in drinks.

ex.en: Some cars can run on fuel mixed with ethanol made from corn.
ex.ko: 어떤 자동차는 옥수수로 만든 에탄올을 섞은 연료로 달릴 수 있다.

easy: The quality of being holy and special to God.

ex.en: The quiet temple had a feeling of holiness.
ex.ko: 조용한 사원에는 신성한 느낌이 감돌았다.

easy: Shown to be part of something wrong.

ex.en: Two boys were implicated in breaking the classroom window.
ex.ko: 두 남자아이가 교실 유리창을 깬 일에 연루되었다.

easy: A person on a jury, a group of people who decide in court if someone is guilty.

ex.en: The juror listened carefully to both sides of the story.
ex.ko: 배심원은 양쪽 이야기를 주의 깊게 들었다.

easy: A kind of cancer in the blood.

ex.en: Doctors helped the boy get better from leukemia.
ex.ko: 의사들은 그 소년이 백혈병에서 회복하도록 도왔다.

easy: A person who suffers or dies for what they believe in.

ex.en: People remember her as a martyr who gave her life for freedom.
ex.ko: 사람들은 그녀를 자유를 위해 목숨을 바친 순교자로 기억한다.

easy: A person who lives in a house or a place.

ex.en: The new occupants of the house next door have two dogs.
ex.ko: 옆집에 새로 이사 온 사람들은 개를 두 마리 키운다.

easy: A strong, harmful drug made from a kind of poppy flower.

ex.en: Long ago, Britain and China fought wars over opium.
ex.ko: 오래전에 영국과 중국은 아편 때문에 전쟁을 벌였다.

easy: Having to do with punishment for breaking laws.

ex.en: The country changed its penal laws to make punishments fairer.
ex.ko: 그 나라는 처벌을 더 공정하게 하려고 형법을 바꾸었다.

easy: To be in charge of a meeting or group.

ex.en: The principal presided over the school meeting.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님이 학교 회의를 주재하셨다.

easy: An open shoe held on your foot with straps.

ex.en: I wore my new sandals to the beach.
ex.ko: 나는 새 샌들을 신고 해변에 갔다.

easy: The use of signs and pictures that stand for ideas.

ex.en: In the story, the color red has a lot of symbolism.
ex.ko: 그 이야기에서 빨간색은 많은 것을 상징한다.

easy: To pull someone into a messy problem or situation.

ex.en: Tom got tangled up in his friends' argument.
ex.ko: 톰은 친구들의 말다툼에 휘말렸다.

easy: A messy, twisted bunch of things like string, hair, or vines.

ex.en: My kite string turned into a big tangle.
ex.ko: 내 연줄이 크게 엉켜 버렸다.

easy: The group of people who are criminals and live by breaking the law.

ex.en: The detective in the movie fought the city's underworld.
ex.ko: 영화 속 형사는 도시의 암흑가와 싸웠다.

easy: The names of some families of emperors who ruled China long ago.

ex.en: The Wei dynasty ruled part of China long ago.
ex.ko: 위나라는 오래전에 중국의 일부를 다스렸다.

easy: A sickness where a person cannot stop drinking alcohol, which hurts their health.

ex.en: Alcoholism can hurt a person's body and their family.
ex.ko: 알코올 중독은 사람의 몸과 가족에게 해를 줄 수 있다.

easy: Not believing that there is a God or any gods.

ex.en: Atheism is the belief that there are no gods.
ex.ko: 무신론은 신이 없다고 믿는 생각이다.

easy: Done in a very obvious way, without even trying to hide it.

ex.en: It was a blatant lie, because there was chocolate all over his face.
ex.ko: 그의 얼굴에 초콜릿이 잔뜩 묻어 있었으니 그건 뻔한 거짓말이었다.

easy: A child who behaves badly and causes a lot of trouble.

ex.en: The little brat kicked sand at everyone in the sandbox.
ex.ko: 그 말썽꾸러기는 모래 놀이터에서 모두에게 모래를 찼다.

easy: On the back of an animal or fish.

ex.en: The shark's dorsal fin stuck up out of the water.
ex.ko: 상어의 등지느러미가 물 위로 솟아 있었다.

easy: To give someone something important to take care of.

ex.en: Mom entrusted me with the key to our house.
ex.ko: 엄마는 나에게 집 열쇠를 맡기셨다.

easy: A death caused by an accident or disaster.

ex.en: Luckily, there were no fatalities in the car crash.
ex.ko: 다행히 그 자동차 사고로 죽은 사람은 없었다.

easy: A happy celebration, like a party or a festival.

ex.en: The whole town joined the festivities on New Year's Day.
ex.ko: 온 마을이 설날 축제에 함께했다.

easy: A person who lives on an island.

ex.en: The islanders ride boats to get to school.
ex.ko: 섬 주민들은 배를 타고 학교에 간다.

easy: The place of something else; used in "in lieu of," meaning "instead of."

ex.en: We got extra recess in lieu of homework.
ex.ko: 우리는 숙제 대신 쉬는 시간을 더 받았다.

easy: A lake or a long, narrow arm of the sea in Scotland.

ex.en: We looked for the famous monster in Loch Ness.
ex.ko: 우리는 네스 호에서 유명한 괴물을 찾아보았다.

easy: Having to do with Martin Luther or the church that follows his teachings.

ex.en: My grandma goes to a Lutheran church every Sunday.
ex.ko: 할머니는 일요일마다 루터교 교회에 가신다.

easy: A member of the church that follows Martin Luther's teachings.

ex.en: Our neighbors are Lutherans who sing in the church choir.
ex.ko: 우리 이웃은 교회 성가대에서 노래하는 루터교 신자들이다.

easy: Having to do with how good something is or what it is like, not how much there is.

ex.en: The teacher wrote qualitative comments, not just a score.
ex.ko: 선생님은 점수만이 아니라 질적인 평가도 적어 주셨다.

easy: An office that keeps records and does paperwork for a big organization.

ex.en: The UN secretariat keeps track of all the meetings.
ex.ko: 유엔 사무국은 모든 회의를 기록하고 관리한다.

easy: Put on the skin, not swallowed.

ex.en: The doctor gave me a topical cream for my rash.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님이 발진에 바르는 크림을 주셨다.

easy: The part of the US government that helps farmers and checks that food is safe.

ex.en: The USDA checks that the meat in stores is safe to eat.
ex.ko: 미국 농무부는 가게에서 파는 고기가 먹어도 안전한지 검사한다.

easy: The government office in charge of a country's navy, especially in Britain.

ex.en: The Admiralty sent new ships out to sea.
ex.ko: 해군성은 새 배들을 바다로 보냈다.

easy: To force someone to do something by threatening to tell their secrets.

ex.en: In the movie, the villain blackmailed the mayor.
ex.ko: 영화에서 악당은 시장을 협박했다.

easy: Getting money from someone by threatening to tell bad things about them.

ex.en: The detective caught the man who used blackmail to get money.
ex.ko: 형사는 협박으로 돈을 뜯어낸 남자를 붙잡았다.

easy: Bright, light yellow, like a canary bird.

ex.en: She wore a bright canary raincoat on the rainy day.
ex.ko: 비 오는 날 그녀는 밝은 카나리아색 우비를 입었다.

easy: Having to do with the Caucasus, a mountain region between Europe and Asia.

ex.en: Georgian is one of the Caucasian languages.
ex.ko: 조지아어는 캅카스 언어 중 하나이다.

easy: A person whose family came from Europe and who has light skin.

ex.en: The form asked us to check a box, like Asian or Caucasian.
ex.ko: 그 서류는 아시아인이나 백인 같은 칸에 표시하라고 했다.

easy: Something that might happen in the future.

ex.en: We packed an umbrella and a first-aid kit for every contingency.
ex.ko: 우리는 만일에 대비해 우산과 구급상자를 챙겼다.

easy: The state of being very poor and not having what you need.

ex.en: The family lived in deprivation after the flood took their home.
ex.ko: 홍수로 집을 잃은 뒤 그 가족은 궁핍하게 살았다.

easy: To make something have more different kinds.

ex.en: The cafeteria diversified its menu with food from many countries.
ex.ko: 급식실은 여러 나라 음식으로 메뉴를 다양하게 했다.

easy: Having to do with the Episcopal church, a Christian church in America.

ex.en: My cousin got married in an Episcopal church.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 성공회 교회에서 결혼했다.

easy: A title used when speaking to an important person like an ambassador, as in "Your Excellency."

ex.en: "Welcome to our school, Your Excellency," said the principal.
ex.ko: "저희 학교에 오신 것을 환영합니다, 각하." 하고 교장 선생님이 말했다.

easy: By the national government of the United States.

ex.en: National parks are federally protected.
ex.ko: 국립공원은 연방 정부의 보호를 받는다.

easy: A wild, excited state where you can't stay calm.

ex.en: The sharks went into a feeding frenzy when the fish were dropped in.
ex.ko: 물고기를 던져 주자 상어들은 미친 듯이 먹어 댔다.

easy: To put someone in a hospital to stay and be treated.

ex.en: Grandpa was hospitalized for two days after he fell.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 넘어지신 뒤 이틀 동안 입원하셨다.

easy: Asking for something again and again and not giving up.

ex.en: At my sister's insistence, we watched her favorite movie again.
ex.ko: 여동생이 하도 졸라서 우리는 그 애가 제일 좋아하는 영화를 또 보았다.

easy: A special anniversary, like the 25th or 50th, or the celebration of it.

ex.en: The school held a big jubilee for its 50th birthday.
ex.ko: 학교는 개교 50주년을 맞아 큰 기념 축제를 열었다.

easy: A very strong, crazy love for something that lots of people suddenly share.

ex.en: There was a mania for trading cards at our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에 카드 교환 열풍이 불었다.
